effect_description_eng:
＜Armor Purge＞ (When this Digimon would be deleted, you may trash the top card of this Digimon to prevent that deletion.)
[On Play] [When Digivolving] [When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] You may suspend 1 Digimon. Then, by choosing 1 of your Digimon, delete the chosen Digimon, and 1 of your opponent's Digimon or Tamers can't unsuspend until their turn ends.
(Rule) Trait: Has [Dinosaur] Type.
